decisions.reason: Its shift from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 suggests weaker revealed demand, and with several alternative fabric options in the portfolio the firm would likely close this option and reallocate resources.

Although only mentioned rather than heavily promoted, it stayed on the website across both years, which for a medium textile firm suggests a viable niche product whose low holding cost justifies keeping the option open.
A dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 signals the strongest commitment and likely the clearest market potential, so there is little reason to abandon it now.

Its continued presence over two years indicates acceptable niche performance, and because assortment extension in textiles can often be maintained at modest incremental cost the firm is likely to keep it for now.

This product appears to overlap with other decorative and bouclé-style launches while never receiving stronger promotion, so the accumulated evidence points to limited upside relative to the rest of the option set.
As a 2024 launch with its own page, it is still early in the learning phase and real-options logic favors retaining it until more market information arrives.
